format: public normalized evidence summary; not the untouched original receipt
normalization: Local absolute paths and credential-named values are omitted. Structured results, statuses and observed failure history are retained. Original bytes remain privately identified by SHA256.

attributes.whatsNew:
Build 33 implements the updated Sets design and the remaining build 32 review fixes.

Browse every piece in a set, add a missing piece with +, and try Undo. Owned pieces stay pink; pieces in the basket use lilac stripes. Basket pieces must never earn a badge or mark a set done before Shopify confirms ownership. Check the exact remainder price, repeated pieces such as Swirl ×2, and returning from a product to the same set position.

My Charms lists all sets in progress, then completed sets and other charms. Check largest-text registration headers, collapsed product headers, Gold finish labels, search cards and collection/share photo backgrounds.

Shared app-only pages now include an outlined Open in app button and Safari guidance. Shopify remains authoritative for products, stock, prices, set membership and verified ownership. The customer website is unchanged.
